structuredContent.body:
Published [0.4.0 alpha](https://github.com/Yoruiopz/Codex-Blender-Bridge/releases/tag/v0.4.0) from the exact commit below. All six downloaded assets match their accepted hashes; the development evidence archive is retained with the release. This PR remains draft and unmerged.

Prepare matching **0.4.0 alpha** packages with tighter bounded weight/export
recovery and a corrected installed-package probe. Weight writes/restoration now
compare independently predicted membership, geometry and context state. Export
retains its exact request/lifecycle, revalidates source and staging scope before
native writes, and stops cleanup after observed authority or scope loss. Unknown
partial effects remain explicit; native exporters remain synchronous.

The installation probe now derives public names from strict `remote` metadata,
includes `toolsets.list`, excludes internal methods, and optionally pins the exact
accepted MCP name inventory. It checks names as well as counts instead of
subtracting a presumed internal tool. The private UV planner and fixture-only
boundary probe remain prerequisites, without a public UV guard or recovery claim.

Final source: `4470d88bb4d8fb1ed75e86090dd6886fb55eb589`, tree
`0353d119fd44ac918dc66d871ef2279576f9312d`. Exact CI artifacts contain matching
0.4.0 add-on, wheel, plugin and checksums; the registry remains at 266 MCP tools.

Validation:

- [CI run 40058140088](https://github.com/Yoruiopz/Codex-Blender-Bridge/actions/runs/40058140088): all seven jobs passed. Each Python 3.10–3.12 × MCP SDK 2.0.0/2.2.0 cell passed **7,582 tests**, with the same three Windows-only skips. Ruff, mypy, inventory, whitespace and source compilation passed.
- Linux Blender 4.5.14/5.2.2: six selected UV-research, weight-brush and limited asset-delivery results passed. These are selected cases, not the complete native inventory or visual acceptance.
- Both Linux builds passed the installed-add-on probe: exact package/import origins and public names, default denial, loopback reconnect, and clean-directory published-0.3.0 upgrade/rollback. Each build used one process; preferences migration/UI uninstall and full installed A–F remain unqualified.
- A **new source-matched 0.4.0 wheel installation and real stdio session** passed under SDK 2.2.0: 266 exact names, core-only defaults and 195 malformed-input checks; installed MCP bytes match the accepted wheel and Git, with no checkout imports or old-session reuse.

All **fourteen stable release requirements remain OPEN**. Windows-specific
compatibility/testing is deferred until implementation is complete and remains
unverified. Safe project saving, protected capture, shader REMOVE, the exact-build
5.2.2 typed-import quarantine, complete native/visual/A–F acceptance and broader
production ownership/recovery remain open. The held animation-provider
investigation is not resumed. This is bounded alpha pre-release evidence, not
stable 1.0 acceptance.

Current UV ownership/recovery guard integration and expanded 4K surface/sculpt work
belong to **0.5 development** and are absent from this 0.4.0 commit/packages. The
[29-item implementation checklist](https://github.com/Yoruiopz/Codex-Blender-Bridge/blob/4470d88bb4d8fb1ed75e86090dd6886fb55eb589/docs/implementation-completion.md)
preserves the full agreed artist-workflow scope.
